mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when PAYEMS growth exceeds 150k/month (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% per annum signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect fails to produce a Rank IC above 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production below 100 (2017=100) indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, which signals deteriorating economic momentum and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to generate a Rank IC above 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 490 billion dollars, combined with rising housing starts, indicates strong consumer and investment demand, which drives corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both RSAFS and HOUST exceed thresholds, or the interaction effect produces a Rank IC below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% after three consecutive months of decline signals labor market weakening, which reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to achieve a Rank IC above 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPI inflation above 2.5% per annum, combined with a stable federal funds rate, indicates inflationary pressures that may prompt future rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5% and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the interaction effect fails to produce a Rank IC above 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real GDP growth below 2.0% annualized, observed over two consecutive quarters, signals a weakening economy, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 2.0% (annualized) in two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the signal fails to generate a Rank IC above 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
